summary: The PETKIT PuraMax 2 costs $210 less and gives you something the PetSnowy does not emphasise: per-cat health tracking, identifying each cat by weight and logging visits, frequency and duration in the app. It has a 76 L interior and two years of coverage. The PetSnowy SNOW+ puts its effort into odour instead, sealing waste after every cycle and using a TiO2 photocatalyst. Both rely on their own bags. Choose on what you want the box to tell you versus what you want it to hide.
chooseA: You want per-cat health data on weight and visit patterns
Price matters: it lists for $210 less
You value two years of included coverage
Your cats are at least six months old and between 3.3 and 22 lb
chooseB: Odour control matters more to you than health data
You want each cycle's waste sealed away
You have the floor space for a 31 in long unit
You prefer an enclosed, odour-first design
